inputs.text: If Cuba is heading toward political change, the danger is that ordinary Cubans—already impoverished and with little property—could be shut out of shaping what comes next. Wealthy diaspora buyers and foreign investors may be better positioned to purchase businesses and property cheaply, turning a transition into another transfer of wealth away from the people who live there. Any change should protect residents’ ability to own, work, and have a real say, rather than treating the island as a bargain for those with money.
